Interface Navigator

All Known Implementing Classes:
KeyboardViewRouter, ViewRouter
public interface Navigator
What a View uses to hand over control. Views are named by the int ids the program registered them under, so a view needs no reference to the others. A request takes effect between frames, never half-way through the view's own touch handler.
